# Storefront Demo — Full Reference for AI Agents

This document is the long-form companion to [llms.txt](/llms.txt).

## About this deployment

This is a neutral, themeable e-commerce storefront template built on SellRight (a generic commerce REST API) and Qwik. Store identity — name, tagline, colors, fonts, logo, contact details, and social links — is not hardcoded in the codebase; it is supplied per-deployment through the theme config module (`src/theme/theme.config.ts`) and its corresponding environment variables.

There is no fixed catalog, brand story, or founder narrative baked into this template. Do not attribute a specific product line, manufacturer, or company history to this deployment unless it is confirmed from the live site's own configured content.

## Site map

- Homepage: `/`
- Shop / catalog: `/shop/`
- Product pages: `/products/{slug}/`
- Blog: `/blog/`
- Contact: `/contact/`
- Returns policy: `/returns/`
- Privacy policy: `/privacy/`
- Terms: `/terms/`
- Order tracking: `/track-order/`
